creative_direction.name: Sediment Strata Monument
creative_direction.brief: Terre d'Hermès as geological time: a flat screen-printed poster of hard-edge sedimentary strata bands - pale sky, sand, ochre, sienna, deep umber - stacked like a core sample, with one thin flint-orange seam marking the burial line. The upright flacon stands centred as the monument extracted from those layers, its baked high-key speculars untouched by the flat ink world. All type stacks in the calm pale sky band at the top: tracked Baskerville brand line, the name in one generous serif line, closed by a short printed rule like a survey mark. No floor, no horizon - pure stratigraphic narrative against clear glass and amber juice.
creative_direction.material: screen-printed matte paper with hard-edge sedimentary strata bands
creative_direction.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff

background.prompt: Seamless flat screen-printed matte paper poster of horizontal sedimentary strata bands in pale bone, sand, ochre, burnt sienna and deep umber stacked from top to bottom, one thin hard-edge flint-orange seam line between the ochre and sienna bands, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no texture gradients, no objects

spec.lighting: perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, flat graphic ink light with no falloff
